topic: Generating Functions and Roots of Unity: The Combinatorial Secret Weapon

sections.title: The Intuitive Bridge: Generating Functions as Infinite Containers
lecture_lines: Sequences hide inside power series coefficients.
Think of exponents as weight, coefficients as counts.
A single die becomes this polynomial.
Generating functions are powerful containers for counting.
animations: Fade in discrete sequence numbers changing into a continuous function curve (#FFCC00).
Morph the curve into a series of terms with exponents (weight) and coefficients (counts) (#00FFCC).
Display the die [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/die.svg] as a geometric polynomial P(x) = sum(a_i * x^i) (#FFFFFF).
Render labeling coefficients as containers with counts (#FF00CC).
Summarize coefficients in Row D as placeholders for event counts using the die [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/die.svg] structure (#FFFF00).

sections.title: The Geometry of Selection: Complex Roots of Unity
lecture_lines: We need to sum specific coefficients.
Roots of unity form regular polygons.
Multiplying by ω acts as a filter.
This sieve cancels out unwanted terms.
animations: Render an algebraic sum of coefficients labeled with color #00CCFF.
Draw a regular polygon with vertices at roots of unity on a complex plane (#FFCC00).
Show rotating through each root vertex point (#FFFFFF).
Animate a filter operation using the rotating vector (omega) to isolate terms [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/filter.svg] (#FF3399).
Demonstrate cancellation of non-target terms using alternating color shifts (#FF0000).
